'''Geris VI''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that occupied the sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position<ref name="CSWE" /> in the [[Geris system/Legends|Geris system]], a part of the [[Trans-Vulta sector/Legends|Trans-Vulta sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point, it became one of the first worlds to ban [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] of<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture<ref name="TrueColors" />&mdash;particularly those hired by the planetary government&mdash;from [[Alcohol/Legends|drinking]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in local [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafs]]. The Mandalorian drinking [[Music/Legends|song]] ''[[Naasad'guur mhi – Mhi n'ulu]]'' dated from that ban.<ref name="TrueColors" />

==Behind the scenes==
Geris VI was first mentioned in ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'', [[Karen Traviss]]' [[2007]] third novel of the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series.<ref name="TrueColors" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Geris [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Geris VI, in grid square O-7.<ref name="TEA" />
